description: Update the auto-icons module to prevent auto-generated icons from overriding user-defined default icons in the public folder. Currently, when auto-icons detects an icon in the source assets directory, it replaces default icons even when they exist in the public folder. The fix should preserve user-provided default icons while still generating icons when needed.
functional_requirements: Modify the auto-icons logic to check for existing default icons in the public directory before generating new ones
Ensure that when a user has placed icons in the public/icon/ directory, those icons are not overwritten by auto-generated icons
Maintain the ability to auto-generate icons when no default icons exist in the public folder
